newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 8.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 8:
WASHINGTON - Grade schools and public libraries would receive hefty discounts on the costs of Internet access beginning next school year under a plan approved by a government advisory panel.
WASHINGTON- America Online Inc. reported a loss of $353.7 million in the quarter that ended Sept. 30.

WASHINGTON - In 10 days, Defense Secretary William Perry is scheduled to eliminate one of three bidders for the largest military contract in history, to build a new fighter jet for the Air Force, Navy and Marines.

WASHINGTON - The negative reaction to reports that officials of Texaco Inc. used racial epithets and planned to destroy personnel documents grew as the president of the NAACP called for a federal probe.
WASHINGTON - The Securities and Exchange Commission filed a $10 million civil lawsuit alleging securities fraud against Systems of Excellence Inc.
